lines.text: Eliphaz the Temanite asks Job whether God rebukes him for his reverence, and says Job's wickedness is great.
Eliphaz says Job withheld food from the famished, and the strength of the fatherless was crushed.
Eliphaz says snares surround Job, and a swarm of locusts covers him in darkness.
Eliphaz says wicked men were snatched away before their time, and fire swept away their foundations.
Eliphaz says if Job consigns Ophir's gold to the stones of the ravines, the Almighty will be his gold.
